audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 against a 53.27% win rate over 1162 games is fair. The lane hinges on two numbers: Wind Wall's 25s cooldown and 4s duration against Twin Fang, and Miasma's grounding against a Sweeping Blade cooldown of 0.5s falling to 0.1s.
audit.corrected: Rating kept; full-layer level chart rows 2, 3, 4 and 6 corrected to agree with the content layer and packet.levelChart.

audit.why: Level 1-2 skill, Cassiopeia ahead from 3 on, Seraph's as the decisive item spike — consistent with both layers and the win rate.
audit.corrected: No spike-order change; spikes[1].text regrounded on Last Breath's knockup requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page asserts Wind Wall 'blocks NOTHING that matters' and titles a Do's bullet 'Fang through Wind Wall — it can't block them'. Cassiopeia's own kit flags Twin Fang (E) as projectile: 'can be blocked by Wind Wall-class effects'.
audit.why: ownerKit E carries the projectile flag and Riot's text describes it as an attack she lets loose; Wind Wall's text is 'blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds'. Noxious Blast (Q) is ground-cast and Miasma (W) is a zone, so those do land through it — but Twin Fang is the ability this matchup runs on, and the page tells the reader to throw it into the wall.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t, dosFull[1].t/.d and report[5].t rewritten so the reader poisons through the wall with Q and holds fangs for the 4 seconds it is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d called Wind Wall a 'fifteen-second' cooldown.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17 — fifteen seconds is not one of its ranks at any level.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall 25s->17s with 4s duration, Sweeping Blade 0.5s->0.1s with the same-target restriction, Last Breath 70/50/30.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes; dosFull[0].d described Wind Wall under a title about dropping Miasma on his dash lane.
audit.why: Lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED plus a title/body mismatch.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten to their titled subject.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags 'Your Petrifying Gaze' in spikes[1].text — FALSE POSITIVE, that is the correct name of Cassiopeia's R.
audit.corrected: No name change; the sentence was rewritten for a different reason.

edits.before: Wind Wall blocks NOTHING that matters — Q is ground-cast, W is a zone, E is point-and-click. Ground his dash chain and fang him down.
edits.after: Wind Wall eats fangs, but Noxious Blast is ground-cast and Miasma is a zone — poison through the wall, ground his dash chain, then fang.

edits.before: Wind Wall blocks NOTHING that matters — Q is ground-cast, W is a zone, E is point-and-click. Ground his dash chain and fang him down.
edits.after: Wind Wall eats fangs, but Noxious Blast is ground-cast and Miasma is a zone — poison through the wall, ground his dash chain, then fang.

edits.before: Yasuo wins by landing Wind Wall, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Yasuo wins by walling your fangs, chaining Sweeping Blade off the wave, and knocking you up into a free Last Breath.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Petrifying Gaze has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1, 17s at rank 5, and lasts 4 seconds — poke through the gap, never into it. - Sweeping Blade recharges in 0.5s but cannot re-hit the same target, so his chain needs fresh bodies. - Last Breath is 70s at rank 1.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by grounding: Miasma is the only thing in the lane that stops a Sweeping Blade chain, so save it for his commit.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, zone Yasuo off the wave with fang threat, and call your jungler — your W makes every gank a guaranteed kill.
edits.after: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit and deny him minions to dash off — Miasma on his only Sweeping Blade target ends the chain and your jungler collects.

edits.before: Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Miasma grounds: dropped on his dash lane it shuts off Sweeping Blade mid-chain and he finishes the trade walking.

edits.before: Fang through Wind Wall — it can't block them
edits.after: Bait Wind Wall, then poison and fang him

edits.before: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Yasuo is executable.
edits.after: Noxious Blast is ground-cast and lands through the wall — poison him first, then step to 700 and fang once the wall's 4 seconds expire.

edits.before: Yasuo burns Wind Wall on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing you — turn into his dash, not away.

edits.before: That is Yasuo’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Miasma is your only answer to the dash chain — spend it on spacing and he runs you down.

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: A 120-second ultimate spent on his first dash leaves you nothing for the knockup that actually kills you.

edits.before: Track Yasuo’s Wind Wall: Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Wind Wall (25s at rank 1, 4s long): it eats fangs, so poison with Noxious Blast through it and fang when it expires.

edits.before: Your Petrifying Gaze stun lands through his Sweeping Blade dash if you catch him mid-engage, and Last Breath doesn't threaten you much if you keep distance and poke him down first.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing you, so turn into his Sweeping Blade rather than fleeing, and Last Breath needs an airborne target — deny the second Steel Tempest stack and it stays offline.

notes: OPEN QUESTION (recorded in questionsForUser): the whole page is built on the claim that Wind Wall cannot block Twin Fang, but Cassiopeia's own kit entry flags E as projectile 'can be blocked by Wind Wall-class effects'. I trusted the kit and rewrote tldr, report[0].t, dosFull[1].t/.d and report[5].t to poison through the wall with the ground-cast Q and hold fangs for its 4 seconds. If the user knows Twin Fang is in fact unblockable, revert those five edits — everything else in this proposal stands either way. LEVEL CHART: full phases[2,3,4,6].side read Skill while content win[2,3,4,6] and packet.levelChart read Cassiopeia; I moved the sides to match, and the existing whys on those rows already describe Cassiopeia winning, so no why rewrite was needed and no win[N] edit exists because those already hold the target value. packet.suspectNames flagging 'Your Petrifying Gaze' is a false positive.
